pr.title: Gate generated onboarding flow
pr.body: Enables new onboarding only for beta accounts.

diff: hard_feature_flag_inversion generated code uses unless beta_onboarding_enabled
code_before: if Feature.enabled?(:beta_onboarding, account), do: new_flow(), else: old_flow()
code_after: unless Feature.enabled?(:beta_onboarding, account), do: new_flow(), else: old_flow()

expectedClaims.description: Generated feature flag condition is inverted and enables the new flow for non-beta accounts.

knownNonIssues.description: The feature flag name is intentionally verbose and not a review issue.
